resources.string: Applies to Direct and Stream downloads, including playlist checks. Uses a confirmed default Wi-Fi connection; unknown routes and VPN routes wait. Recording and local editing are unaffected. After interruption, resume Direct manually; incomplete streams must be selected again from the webpage and start over.
Saving is waiting for a confirmed default Wi-Fi connection. Connect to Wi-Fi or turn off Save only over Wi-Fi, then retry manually.
The stream download stopped for the Wi-Fi setting. Return to the webpage and select the stream again; the new task starts over. You can cancel this task.
Saving preferences are not confirmed yet. Wait for settings to load, or explicitly choose the Wi-Fi saving setting before downloading.
